description: Split a Safetensors file at tensor boundaries or combine shards into one file. A split ZIP includes an index mapping tensor names to shards. Static parsing within a 32 MiB combined input budget. No inference, Python imports or pickle execution. Reported compatibility is structural, not a guarantee a framework will load a model. A tensor is never split across files. Duplicate tensor names or conflicting metadata are rejected. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.
name: model_shards
title: Split or merge Safetensors
